Subject: Acme Health – Private Deploy onboarding: connectivity & contract next steps

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is excited to move our Private deployment forward. Procurement asked me to pull together our current network constraints and confirm a handful of questions so they can route the PO + contract. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirmation of Redwood's egress IP range for outbound model calls and telemetry
- Required firewall ports for agent/bastion and any inbound callbacks
- KMS integration options (customer-managed keys) and whether HSM is supported
- Expected timeline from signed MPA to Day-0 access (we need to coordinate with our infra change window)

I can loop in our infra lead Michael Jones if needed — attaching our current VPC sketch (acme-vpc-topology-v1.pdf) and a short procurement checklist.

Would you be available for a 30-min sync Thursday morning PT to align on the technical asks + signoff path?

Thanks,
Sara Tan
Sr. Engineering Program Manager
Acme Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:06:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Acme Health – Private Deploy onboarding: connectivity & contract next steps

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the topology sketch. We're aligned to proceed and I drafted a minimal MPA for procurement to accelerate signature — attaching redwood-mpa-draft-20261021.pdf.

Short answers up front:
- Egress: we provide a stable egress CIDR block for regional hosting; we'll confirm the precise /24 ranges before Day-0 but can lock an allowlist during staging.
- Firewall ports: inbound management (SSH bastion) + agent health check ports (TLS) — Ben will list exact ports and protocol expectations below.
- KMS: customer-managed keys supported via KMS integration (AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault). HSM via partner-managed modules is supported for enterprise plans — we'll include our compliance team notes.
- Timeline: typical timeline is 2–4 weeks post-signature for VPC peering + account provisioning, faster if procurement/Docusign flows are swift and we get network contact details.

Proposal: 30-min sync Thu 09:00 PT to run through the network questions and agree MPA signers. Ben and Karthik will cover the technical checklist; Laura will handle procurement handoffs.

Next steps I will take today:
1) Share our technical onboarding checklist (Ben)
2) Share draft MPA (attached) for your legal/procurement review
3) Post-sync: open a HubSpot deal activity and share DocuSign link

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-mpa-draft-20261021.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sara Tan <sara.tan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Acme Health – Private Deploy onboarding: connectivity & contract next steps

Sara / team — quick technical checklist and clarifying questions to prep for the Thu sync. I've attached a simple network diagram stub for our orientation (acme-network-diagram.pdf).

Network & connectivity checklist (high level):
1) VPC topology: confirm whether you want VPC peering (Redwood-managed transit) or client-managed peering via VPN/Direct Connect.
2) Egress allowlist: we can provide region-specific CIDR(s). Please confirm which AWS region your VPC is in and whether you require static IPs for both control plane and telemetry.
3) Inbound ports for Day-0:
   - 22/TCP (SSH) -> bastion (optional; we support session-based access via jumpbox)
   - 443/TCP (HTTPS) -> management/agent endpoints
   - 5671/5672 (optional) -> message queues if you're integrating event streams
4) NAT & Egress: if you use NAT gateways, ensure outbound NAT preserves the source IP for allowlisting or we can provide an egress proxy.
5) KMS integration: provide the KMS key ARN and an IAM role for Redwood to assume. If using HSM, please share vendor and certs; we'll map our compliance checklist.
6) DNS & certificate: if you want private DNS names, share the internal zone; otherwise we'll use a Redwood-managed hostname.
7) Monitoring & logs: we push audit logs to a customer-S3/Azure Blob or can mirror into your logging tenant — confirm retention needs.

Questions for you before Thu:
- Which peering model do you prefer? (peer / transit / vpn)
- Do you need dedicated GPU nodes in a specific AZ?
- Who will be the network contact for firewall changes?

Attachment: acme-network-diagram.pdf (diagram stub, not a final layout).

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Jones <michael.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Tan <sara.tan@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Acme Health – Private Deploy onboarding: connectivity & contract next steps

Thanks Ben / Kim — answers below inline and attaching an updated topology (acme-vpc-topology-v1.pdf).

- Peering model: we prefer transit via AWS Transit Gateway to centralize routing across accounts.
- Region/AZ: us-west-2, multiple AZs. We will request dedicated GPU nodes in us-west-2a for predictable performance.
- Egress: we can accept a single /24 allowlist for outbound to Redwood; please send the CIDR(s) and expected DNS names.
- Ports: we'll open 443/TCP and provision a bastion for 22/TCP access limited to Redwood-admin IPs. No AMQP ports required.
- KMS: we'll provide KMS key ARNs and create an IAM role for Redwood. HSM is not required at launch.
- Network contact: me (michael.jones@acmehealth.com) and our infra lead (infra-support@acmehealth.com).

Procurement note: legal is reviewing the MPA; procurement would like the MPA and a separate SOW that lists deliverables and the Day-0 acceptance criteria. Can Redwood split the MPA & SOW or should we sign the combined MPA as drafted?

We can confirm Thu 09:00 PT if that still works.

-Michael

Subject: Re: Acme Health – Private Deploy onboarding: connectivity & contract next steps

Thanks Michael — that all looks good and clears most points. Confirming next steps and owners: 

1) Contract path (Laura Bennett): we can split the paperwork into MPA + SOW. Laura will own the SOW draft and will send a version by COB Friday. HubSpot deal will note separate signature milestones.
2) Technical onboarding (Ben/Karthik): Ben will share final port list and the egress CIDR(s) by EOD Thu; Karthik will prepare the Day-0 runbook and AZ placement recommendations for dedicated nodes.
3) KMS & IAM (Priyom): Priyom will share an integration checklist and a template IAM policy; Acme to provision role and key ARN.
4) Logistics: Kimberly to open DocuSign activity and share link. Once MPA + SOW are routed, engineering will schedule Day-0 prep (typically within 2 weeks of fully executed paperwork).

Links: HubSpot deal activity (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACM-2026-048) and DocuSign session (https://documents.redwood.ai/docusign/ACM-048-sign). We will also upload SOC2 evidence into the secure share after procurement confirms the list — expected upload by Mon.

Confirming Thu 09:00 PT — invite sent. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
